dct_description_sm:
This dataset includes various offers related to nature and outdoor sports. Among other things, there are national and regional parks, wildlife reserves, equestrian centers, equestrian centers, marinas, skating rinks, beaches, downhill ski centers, cross-country ski centers, golf courses, ice fishing centers.

Please note that this dataset is an overview of the tourist offer in Quebec and is not intended to identify the entire offer. This data comes from the Quebec Tourism Information System (SIT Quebec).

In addition, if your interest lies in obtaining official indicators and statistics on the Quebec tourism industry, we invite you to explore the Tourism Studies and Statistics section of the Québec.ca site at the following link: https://www.quebec.ca/tourisme-et-loisirs/services-industrie-touristique/etudes-statistiques.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
